為賺取更豐厚利息及回報，更快達至理財目標，您可隨時增加定期 /非定期供款以累積財富。

Flexible Increase of Premium
To achieve your financial goals faster with higher returns, you can increase regular or unscheduled premiums at any time to accumulate wealth.

靈活套現
只要保單內已累積有足夠的現金價值，您可行使定期提款權益，自由設定每月 / 每年提款金額及年期，讓各項理財安排（例如子女升學及退休等）更有規劃。此外，您亦可隨時提取部分現金價值，以應不時之需。

Greater Liquidity
When your Policy has accumulated a Cash Value, you can exercise the automatic periodic withdrawal option to withdraw a specified amount of Cash Value monthly / annually at preset time intervals, so that you can easily map out your financial needs, e.g. children's university education funds and retirement expenses. In addition, you can withdraw a portion of the Cash Value at any time to cope with emergencies.

暫停繳付保費
若需要應急，只要保單內已累積有足夠的現金價值，您可暫停繳付保費，令理財更具彈性。

Skip Premium Payments
When your Policy has accumulated a Cash Value, you may skip premium payments to cope with emergencies.

Cash withdrawal, reducing the premium amount, or skipping premium payments will afect the accumulation of the Cash Value, while the monthly charges are still deductible. If the Cash Value is not suficient to cover the monthly charges, the Policy will lapse with zero value.

失業保障
萬一投保人於保單有效期內不幸遭裁員或遣散，即可享有長達365日的「特惠寬限期」，於該期限內仍可繼續享有十足保障。

Unemployment Protection
Should the Policy Owner be made redundant, there is an option which allows suspension of premium payments for 365 days. During this entire "Special Grace Period", you will remain fully covered by the insurance .

末期病症保障
若受保人不幸被首次確診患上末期病症，便可獲得末期病症保障賠償，即基本計劃及附加保障（如適用）的身故保障，以紓緩經濟上的壓力。

Terminal Illness Benefit
In the event of the Insured being first diagnosed with Terminal Illness , a sum of Terminal Illness Benefit will be paid, which is the Death Benefit of the basic plan and supplementary benefit(s) (if any), to help relieve the financial burden.
